Phase 5 – Response Personalization & Context Memory
Objective

Tailor AI responses based on persona, previous queries, and intent context.

Enable multi-turn conversations with memory of past interactions.

Apply persona-driven responses (Sales Advisor, Technical Advisor, FAQ Bot, Pilot Onboarding Assistant).

Memory Slots & Context Variables
Memory Slot	Description	Example Usage
user_name	Stores user’s name	"Hi {user_name}, welcome back!"
user_company	Company name	"For {user_company}, we recommend the Strategic pilot."
previous_intent	Last detected intent	Adjust follow-up questions or refine advice
preferred_service	User’s chosen service	Personalize pitch for YouTube, VSO, CGI, etc.
pilot_status	Tracks pilot progress	"Your CGI video is in production (Step 2/4)."
open_questions	Unresolved queries	Follow up automatically with FAQs or next steps
persona_context	AI persona tone	Sales Advisor = persuasive, FAQ Bot = informative
